articles.title: Kentucky court allows sale of land transferred for $1 to cover $177,668 debt
articles.description: A property transfer for just $1 has failed to shield a Kentucky couple’s land from a creditor seeking to recover an unpaid debt. In an October 23, 2026, opinion, the Kentucky Court of Appeals upheld an order allowing property assessed at approximately $210,000 to be sold to satisfy a judgment of $177,667.88, plus applicable costs and attorney fees.

articles.title: A Colorado family spent over 100 years raising cattle and growing crops on 10,000 acres; then 30 wind turbines added another income stream to their ranch
articles.description: The Kochis family revitalized their historic ranch, creating the Rush Creek Wind Farm while preserving their farming legacy. Featuring 30 wind turbines, this harmonious operation generates consistent revenue, all while they cultivate crops and raise livestock. With steady earnings that aren't influenced by weather or market swings, the project also boosts local economies through construction jobs and tax benefits, illustrating a shift towards renewable energy in rural American agriculture.

articles.title: Industrial growth may ease to 6% in September as capital goods, mining lose steam
articles.description: In September 2026, India's industrial production growth is anticipated to decline to 6%, down from 8% in August. Notably, capital goods production is projected to drop significantly to 2.2%, from an impressive 16.9% the previous month. Additionally, mining output is expected to contract by 8%, indicating a cooling growth trend, although vehicle sales and infrastructure goods remain robust.

articles.title: Peter Lynch on stock picking: 'You shouldn't own a stock if you can't…'
articles.description: Peter Lynchs investing advice centres on understanding a company before buying its stock. The legendary Fidelity Magellan Fund manager stresses researching business fundamentals, growth prospects and financials rather than investing based on popularity or hearsay.

articles.title: Microtek invests over Rs 400 cr to accelerate solar business growth
articles.description: Microtek has announced a significant investment over Rs 400 crore for its solar business expansion in Jaipur. The new solar panel manufacturing plant is expected to become operational by November 2026 and will support the company's energy vision. The company is also highlighting its new Battery Energy Storage System to improve energy management for households.

articles.title: Satellite lights, Google Trends can help estimate state growth: RBI report
articles.description: Combining night-time illumination and Google Trends data reduced errors in quarterly growth estimates by up to 62 per cent across three industrial states

articles.title: NCERT rolls out 20-hour AI, computational thinking module for classes 9-12
articles.description: The National Council of Educational Research and Training has introduced a module on computational thinking and artificial intelligence for students. This 20-hour course is designed for students in grades 9 to 12 with no prior AI knowledge. It emphasizes critical thinking, creativity, and responsible technology use while covering ethical AI applications. The module includes activity-based learning to enhance understanding of AI concepts, applications, and limitations.

articles.title: FPIs withdraw Rs 48,056 cr from equities in Oct so far amid elevated crude oil prices
articles.description: Foreign investors withdrew significant funds from Indian equities in October amid concerns over inflation and crude oil prices. Despite this, there were signs of moderation in selling with two days of net buying. The overall FPI outflows from equities in 2026 have reached notable levels compared to previous years. Market participants are closely monitoring upcoming macroeconomic developments including US GDP data.

articles.title: Buyer pays $1.65 million deposit luxury condo, home remains unfinished four years later
articles.description: Nilesh Undavia and other buyers are struggling to receive their deposits for unfinished luxury condos in Boca Raton. The Mandarin Oriental Residences project has faced significant construction delays, impacting buyers' financial investments. A $417.7 million foreclosure lawsuit complicates the situation for prospective homeowners seeking refunds. Penn-Florida Companies attributes delays to various challenges, including rising construction costs and supply-chain issues.

articles.title: eMudhra’s SSL/TLS exit leaves questions over weak-key lapse and security controls
articles.description: The cryptographic flaw that went undetected for around 18 months, raises questions about internal safeguards, independent verification, and the assurances that the company’s other businesses remain unaffected.

articles.title: CBI books IL&FS Energy, executives in alleged Rs 212 crore Canara Bank loan fraud case
articles.description: The Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case against IL&FS Energy Development Company and its executives over loan fraud. This case involves an alleged loss of Rs 212.34 crore linked to Canara Bank. The fraud stems from loans sanctioned by Syndicate Bank that were reportedly diverted from their intended projects. CBI conducted searches at multiple locations and seized various important documents related to the case.

articles.description: Shabari Naturals, an initiative from Maharashtra, has received the G-Mark Global Design Award for its packaging. The packaging is inspired by traditional tribal art forms and cultural elements. Prime Minister Narendra Modi acknowledged the honor for promoting tribal products globally. Shabari Naturals aims to empower tribal communities by marketing their natural and organic products.

articles.title: US Midterms 2026: Audi’s $4.2 billion bet gives Trump tariff ammo in battleground Georgia
articles.description: Trump is defending his tariff policy ahead of the US midterms, touting Volkswagen’s $4.2 billion investment in Audi’s first US plant in Georgia as a manufacturing win. The project promises 4,500 jobs, but Republican candidates face mounting voter concerns over inflation, living costs and Trump’s falling approval ratings.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan said that they shifting their donations, just weeks after Meta CEO gifted state of California ...
articles.description: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan are investing $50 million to establish STEM labs and an AI center at Sacramento State University. This generous donation aims to transform vacant state office buildings into a thriving downtown campus. California Governor Gavin Newsom emphasized this initiative will enhance the tech job talent pipeline, while the couple shifts their philanthropic efforts toward biomedical AI, aligning with Meta’s vision for innovation and education.

articles.title: Karnataka's CM DK Shivakumar OKs IAS officer's prosecution in KPSC exam paper leak case
articles.description: Karnataka's Chief Minister D K Shivakumar has approved the prosecution of IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar. This decision relates to allegations of corruption involving the Karnataka Public Service Commission examination. Gangwar is accused of leaking exam questions to an accomplice while serving as controller of examinations. The investigation is being conducted by the CID's Special Investigation Team and the Enforcement Directorate.

articles.title: Who is Dave Doeren? NC State fires head coach in the middle of his 14th season after 3-4 start and now owes him $10.3 million
articles.description: Following a disappointing 31-28 loss against Stanford, North Carolina State University has parted ways with head coach Dave Doeren after 14 seasons. Doeren's tenure saw him become the winningest coach in the school's history with a 95-70 record. This year, NC State finds itself in a tough spot at 3-4, notably with the second-worst defense in the ACC.

Sebi's vision encompasses streamlining regulations, promoting responsible technology, fostering deeper market engagement, and ensuring broader access for investors, particularly in underrepresented smaller towns and villages, while urging brokers to assess client risks more comprehensively.

articles.description: Anahat Singh, an 18-year-old squash player, achieved significant victories at the Silicon Valley Open in California. She defeated her childhood idol, Nour El Sherbini, and another higher-ranked player, Salma Hany. Anahat's recent performances include winning medals at the Asian Games and breaking into the world’s top 20. With aspirations set on the 2028 Olympics, she is recognized as a rising talent in squash.
